name: ref-pane
description: A pane of references like RV-1/FB-2/T-3 from the model reply: a click shows the ticket artifact section right in the session

prefixes.title: Artifact prefixes
prefixes.description: Custom comma-separated list of PREFIX=dir entries (1–4 uppercase Latin letters), for example: RV=review, FB=feedback, T=tasklist. Without an equals sign, the directory is the lowercase prefix. Replaces the default set (RV, FB, T, TASK, ADR, DBG, OQ, BQ, RD, D, Q, FR, NFR, AC, US); empty means the defaults are used.
